evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy.
